regions.name: startup
regions.evidence: PS-X startup clears BSS, establishes stack and GP, runs constructor tables, and transfers control to the game entry routine.

regions.name: game
regions.evidence: Game and engine code, bounded by the startup transfer and the embedded SDK getter at 0x80058F10.

regions.name: embedded-sdk-getter
regions.evidence: Sixteen bytes of SDK assembly embedded in the game span. The GsGetWorkBase identification was withdrawn as a misidentification; the region boundary itself is unaffected.

regions.name: game-after-libgs-getter
regions.evidence: Game and engine code following the embedded LIBGS getter and ending at the first SN/PsyQ host-I/O break wrapper.

regions.name: sdk
regions.evidence: SN host-I/O wrappers, anchored PsyQ library RCS strings, Sony library data, hardware APIs, GTE routines, libc, memory-card, CD, GPU, SPU, and MDEC code.
